title: Totient tail carry period: no-go bounds, directed certificates, and mod-four pulse reduction

concepts.label: absolute adjugate tail cost
concepts.note: The crude two-tail error budget of an exact rational totient-isolating row.

concepts.label: primitive-Mersenne congruence no-go
concepts.note: A multiplicative rational control showing that a Mersenne divisor alone does not annihilate an integral shift.

concepts.label: cofinal mod-four totient pulse
concepts.note: Prime positions at which a 4h-shifted totient increment is 2 modulo 4.

concepts.label: directed central-arc certificate
concepts.note: The asymmetric certificate retaining distinct lower and upper tail radii.

concepts.label: cofinal directed LCM supply
concepts.note: Directed kills at arbitrarily large diagonal periodLcm scales.

concepts.label: cofinal mod-four pulse-survivor supply
concepts.note: The unresolved finite-state producer sufficient to convert cofinal arithmetic pulses into irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED NO-GO: any finite rational row w that exactly isolates one totient channel, sum_i w_i*phi(x_i)=1, has totientAdjugateTailCost w x at least 3; therefore that cost can never satisfy the strict threshold cost<1.
statement_nodes.engine: Triangle inequality, phi(x)<=x, and the coefficientwise two-tail reconstruction cost 3x+4.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked obstruction to the specific absolute-value adjugate estimate; no broader novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This excludes only the crude termwise absolute-tail budget. It does not exclude cancellation-sensitive inverse methods, other reconstruction norms, or Erdős #249 itself.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONTROL COUNTERMODEL: for every 0<K<q with q dividing 2^K-1, the completely multiplicative control c(n)=n has rational binary series value 2 and, at every N, an integral K-shift equal to K that is nonzero modulo q.
statement_nodes.engine: The exact control tail binaryCoeffTail id N=N+2, so every K-shift equals K; the strict inequality K<q prevents q from dividing it.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project control example delimiting a proof strategy; no claim about the actual totient sequence is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The countermodel is c(n)=n, not phi(n). It proves that divisibility by a factor of 2^K-1 plus integrality alone is insufficient; a totient-specific restriction may still succeed.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ARITHMETIC SUPPLY: for every h>0 and threshold B, there is a prime p>B with deltaTotient (4*h) p congruent to 2 modulo 4.
statement_nodes.engine: Choose a fresh prime r congruent to 1 modulo 4 and use Dirichlet on a coprime progression forcing p congruent to 3 modulo 4 while r divides p+4h.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked CRT/Dirichlet totient pulse producer; no external priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem supplies only the arithmetic pulse. It does not kill the finite candidate states left by the carry recurrence and therefore does not imply irrationality alone.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: REPRESENTATION: directedCertifiedKill h N L requires the length-L discrepancy residue modulo 2^L to lie between the lower bound N+L+2 and the upper bound 2^L-(N+h+L+2), retaining the two directed tail radii separately.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition is decidable but does not assert that any cell fires. This selected role alone neither states soundness/completeness nor supplies a cofinal family.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: OPEN PREDICATE: CofinalDirectedLcmCertificateSupply requires that beyond every t0 there is t>=t0 and a depth L for which directedCertifiedKill (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t) L holds.
open_antecedents: A cofinal supply of directed certificate depths on the diagonal cells (periodLcm t, periodLcm t).
statement_nodes.engine: Named packaging of a cofinal family of decidable directed certificate cells.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition has no inhabitant in this selected evidence. A later theorem in the source identifies its exact ceiling, but that theorem is outside this bounded role packet.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: OPEN CONDITIONAL REDUCTION: if for every h>0 and threshold B there is a prime p>B with deltaTotient (4*h) p congruent to 2 modulo 4 and some finite modFourPulseSurvivorKill at (4*h,p), then the totient series is irrational.
open_antecedents: For every h>0 and B, a cofinal mod-four pulse prime p together with a finite K satisfying modFourPulseSurvivorKill (4*h) p K.
statement_nodes.engine: Rationality gives eventual integrality at a primitive period; multiplying the period by four and using the pulse forces a 2-mod-4 carry state, which the supplied finite survivor kill excludes.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked reduction to a project-specific finite-state producer; no producer or solution claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The arithmetic pulse theorem proves only the pulse part of the antecedent. The survivor-kill supply remains unproved, so this theorem does not settle Erdős #249.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The supply predicate quantifies the directed certificate over cofinally many diagonal LCM cells.
The arithmetic theorem independently supplies the cofinal pulse-prime component, while the conditional reduction additionally requires the unproved finite survivor-kill component.
The control countermodel shows why a homogeneous Mersenne divisor is insufficient, while the mod-four theorem supplies genuinely totient-specific residue information.
The first node closes a crude global reconstruction route; the latter isolates a different residue-and-finite-state route with an explicit open producer.
